items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Madelyn told her that she was the real Mrs.Coleman because I was not divorced from her. Beezie knew that but she had never seen her and Madelyn had never bothered me until she heard that I was living with a girl who was calling herself Mrs. Coleman.

ctx.x: Things started going badly with her step-father and eventually she came to live with some friends in New York and when I moved into my one room appartment, Beezie and I started living together.

Everything was fine until my wife whom I had been separated from, almost two years, found out that I was living with a girl and one night when she knew I was at work, she came to see what Beezie was like and that really must have upset her, because Beezie was a very pretty girl who had blue eyes, wavy dark red hair and looked like a white girl. Madelyn told her that she was the real Mrs.Coleman because I was not divorced from her. Beezie knew that but she had never seen her and Madelyn had never bothered me until…

And not long after Madelyn's visit, I received a notice to appear in the domestic court on a certain day. I was ordered to pay five dollars a week alimony to Madelyn. I had no cut because I was the one that had left her. She didn't really need the money because she was working and making a nice salary for a woman. But she was getting revenge because I was with someone else.
